result.instructions: Tools for CashCtrl, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still open and who owes us money?"; "What is our income statement for the current fiscal year?"; "Show the bookkeeping entries from last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CashCtrl data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cashctrl_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cashctrl_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cashctrl_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cashctrl_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cashctrl_create_journal_entry
tools.title: Create a journal entry
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates a manual book entry in the journal. Either a simple entry (debit_account_id, credit_account_id, amount) or a collective entry (items, whose debit and credit sums must match). POST /journal/create.json.

date.description: Booking date, yyyy-mm-dd (CashCtrl uses today when omitted).

debit_account_id.description: Debit account id (cashctrl_list_accounts). For a simple entry.

credit_account_id.description: Credit account id (cashctrl_list_accounts). For a simple entry.

amount.description: Amount of a simple entry, for example 125.50.

items.description: Lines of a collective entry. Use it instead of debit_account_id, credit_account_id and amount.

debit.description: Amount on the debit side; give debit or credit.

credit.description: Amount on the credit side; give debit or credit.

tax_id.description: Tax code id of a simple entry (cashctrl_list_tax_codes).

sequence_number_id.description: Sequence number that generates the reference (cashctrl_list_sequence_numbers).

associate_id.description: The person this entry belongs to (cashctrl_list_persons).

tools.name: cashctrl_delete_journal_entries
tools.title: Delete journal entries
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. DELETES manual journal entries by id (entries created by orders or salary statements cannot be deleted this way). Deleted entries are gone from the books; confirm the ids with the user first. POST /journal/delete.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates ONE order document for ONE customer or vendor: a quote, invoice, credit note, purchase bill and so on, depending on category_id. Without status_id the first status of the category is used; a booking status (for example Open) also creates journal entries, so use a draft status unless the user asks otherwise. No e-mail is sent. POST /order/create.json.

category_id.description: Order category id (cashctrl_list_order_categories), for example the Invoice category.

account_id.description: Revenue account id (sales) or expense account id (purchase), from cashctrl_list_accounts.

unit_id.description: Unit id (pieces, hours; from the units of the inventory).

discount_percentage.description: Discount of this item in percent.

status_id.description: Status id (cashctrl_list_order_categories). Default: the first status of the category.

nr.description: Order number. Leave empty to use the sequence number of the category.

sequence_number_id.description: Sequence number for the order number (cashctrl_list_sequence_numbers).

account_id.description: Debtors or creditors account id; default from the category.

discount_percentage.description: Discount of the whole order in percent.

tools.name: cashctrl_update_order_status
tools.title: Change the status of orders
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Sets the status of 1-20 orders (for example Draft to Open, or Open to Paid). A status can book journal entries or move stock, so the books change. POST /order/update_status.json.

status_id.description: The new status id (from the statuses of the order category, cashctrl_list_order_categories).

tools.name: cashctrl_delete_orders
tools.title: Delete orders
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. DELETES orders (invoices, quotes, purchase documents) by id, with the journal entries they created. Deleted documents are gone; confirm the ids with the user first. POST /order/delete.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_create_person
tools.title: Create a person or company
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates a customer, vendor or other contact. Give company, first_name or last_name (at least one). Search first with cashctrl_list_persons so no duplicate is created. POST /person/create.json.

nr.description: Person number, for example the customer number.

language.description: Language of documents for this person.

vat_uid.description: VAT number (UID), for example CHE-123.456.789 MWST.

address.description: Street and number; may have several lines.

country.description: Country as a 3-letter code, for example CHE, DEU, AUT.

contacts.description: E-mail addresses, phone numbers and websites.

address.description: The e-mail address, phone number or URL.
